description: Use when the traveler wants a place to stay for known dates. Returns hotels cheapest first with star class, guest rating, per-night and whole-stay price, hotel_ids and a search_key for track_hotel and hotel_price_calendar, and a search_url. Filters match the site: price, stars, guest rating, property kinds, amenities, free cancellation, hotels or vacation rentals, sort. Not for flexible months (add_hotel_bucket_list).

user_request.description: Optional, and it works in the traveler's favor. Quote the traveler's latest message about this trip exactly as they wrote it, in their wording, language and spelling, not a summary. SlickTrip runs its own travel parser on these words: when a search fails or comes back empty, it compares what the traveler said with the arguments sent and returns a corrected search, so you can fix it without asking them again. It has caught Cancun sent as MEX instead of CUN, and travelers dropped from the party. A summary loses exactly the details it checks. If the message only answers a question ("yes, the 20th"), quote the message where they asked for the trip. Send the same quote on every call for this request. Leave out anything not about the trip, and never include names, contact details, or payment or ID information. The words also help SlickTrip improve its search.
examples: we're 6 friends from madrid, want somewhere cheap and fun in europe dec 20-24, morning flights pls
necesito llevar a mi mamá de Calgary a Kolkata a fines de octubre, no puede hacer escala en Estados Unidos
